title: 5 days that ended Jensen Huang's reign at Nvidia

scenes.say: Okay? What just happened? In just five days, the most powerful man in AI lost his job. So here's your timeline, but day five is brutal.
Sunday. Jensen Huang tells his staff in a memo that he was unfaithful to his wife. But you ain't seen nothing yet.
Then the reports land. The New York Times says there was a second relationship, with an employee. And others say US officials linked a woman to Chinese spies, so things get serious.
Wednesday. The Wall Street Journal says the board is getting ready to push him out. So Nvidia's stock starts to wobble.
Thursday. He resigns, effective immediately. So the finance boss, Colette Kress, takes over for now, and Nvidia gets its first ever chair.
